text: Maria H: Heads up — our US-WEST P4d Savings Plan and several RI SKUs for a100 expired/rolling in 18 days, utilization looks uneven across accounts.
Maria H: summary from cost scanner: total committed = $94k/mo, used ~62%, unused ~38% (mostly on p4d and a100 in us-west-2).
Kevin L: ugh. Is that 38% across the entire commitment or concentrated in specific AZs/accounts?
Maria H: concentrated. dev and staging accounts show 55-70% unused. prod is ~90% utilized. cross-account sharing not enabled for these RIs.
Devon R: Can we split renewals by account/region? Laddering would help — smaller commitments for dev/staging, keep large prod pool.
Prasanna S: We should also consider converting standard RIs -> regional SAs or Savings Plans where possible. SP gives more flexibility across instance families.
Maria H: Agree. Quick data dump attached by bot:

ops-bot: cost-scan report: 
```
  sku,region,account,committed_hours,used_hours,util_pct
  p4d.24xlarge,us-west-2,prod,720,680,94%
  p4d.24xlarge,us-west-2,staging,720,220,31%
  a100.80gb,us-west-2,dev,720,180,25%
  a100.80gb,us-west-2,prod,720,610,85%
  ```
Kevin L: If we convert the dev/staging RIs to regional savings plans we might lose some discount but gain flexibility — what's the net delta?

Prasanna S: Rough calc: current effective discount ~45% on those RIs. SP would be ~35% for same commitment shape. But SP allows family mixing so effective utilization could rise -> net ROI possibly better.
Devon R: Action items: (1) run a 90-day utilization query per account+instancefamily (Devon) (2) model SP vs RI for dev/staging (Prasanna) (3) propose laddered renewal options for prod (Maria)
Maria H: Devon — can you kick off the query and paste the query & results here? Use `reservation-manager query --window 90d --group account,instanceFamily,region`
Devon R: On it. Will drop numbers in ~15m. Also tagging @Kevin L for approvals if we suggest exchanging any convertible RIs.
Kevin L: FYI finance prefers 12/24 month laddering for predictable cashflow. If numbers support it we can do a mid-size 12mo for staging and 24mo for prod.
Prasanna S: Note that some of the older RIs are convertible with limited exchange paths — I'll enumerate which SKUs are convertible vs fixed.

Devon R: query results pasted: 
```
  account,instanceFamily,region,committed_vCPU_hours,used_vCPU_hours,util_pct
  prod,p4d,us-west-2,172800,164400,95%
  staging,p4d,us-west-2,172800,54000,31%
  dev,a100,us-west-2,172800,43200,25%
  ```

Maria H: Thanks. Recommendation draft: 
- Cancel/avoid renewing cross-account RIs for dev/staging. 
- Convert convertible SKUs into Regional Savings Plans sized to match 60% of current commit for dev & staging (gives room for growth). 
- Keep prod commitments as-is but ladder 24mo + 12mo mix. 
- Enable sharing or use consolidated billing family reservations where possible.
Kevin L: Sounds reasonable. Please add cost delta numbers and a 6-month re-eval checkpoint. I can ok up to $20k net increase in month-1 if utilization efficiency improves in quarter.
Prasanna S: I'll check exchange windows & any penalty for early sell/modify. Also will surface which zones/marketplace SKUs block conversion.
Devon R: I'll prepare the model and open a short PR with the numbers and a recommended purchase matrix. Targeting review by EOD Friday.
Maria H: Perfect. Assigning owners: Devon -> utilization query + model; Prasanna -> conversion feasibility & SKU map; Kevin -> finance signoff; Maria -> rollout plan. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: One more ask — include a fallback: if SP uptake fails, we can do temporary burst-on-demand in ap-northeast to offload low-priority training. Will cost more but preserves commit.
Maria H: Noted. We'll include that scenario. Closing for now, will reconvene after Devon posts the PR.
Devon R: PR posted: https://git.internal/repo/commitment-models/pull/242 — comments welcome.
Prasanna S: Reviewing the PR now.
ops-bot: Reminder: renewal window opens in 14 days for US-WEST-2 commitments.
Maria H: Thanks everyone — good momentum.
